topic: North Cyprus territorial/state-unit classification for El-Sen actions
detail: FES notes the Republic of Cyprus is internationally recognized as government of the entire island while the north is administered by the self-declared TRNC, recognized only by Turkey. The demonstrations target northern administration legislation/utility policy. Preserve for review; do not resolve silently.
The newsletter confirms Tip-Is members gathered outside Nicosia State Hospital, but no simultaneous count is reported; follow-up coverage needed to assess ≥50.

topic: April 14 El-Sen power-station gathering scale and direct state target
